# vergeio_vm_import (Data Source)

Reads one `vm_imports` row so a configuration can depend on an import that Ansible or the VergeOS UI already started. Set `id` to the 40 character hex key, or `name` to the import name. VergeOS does not require that name to be unique. A name that matches two rows is an error.

`wait` is omitted by default, and the read blocks until the status is `complete` or `warning`. `error` and `aborted` return immediately, with `status_info` and the error log lines. Set `wait = false` to read the current row, including one that is still importing. `timeout` defaults to 10 minutes.

This data source does not start an import. [`vergeio_vm_import`](../resources/vm_import.html) (resource) does.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Wait for an import that Ansible or the UI already started.
# Omit wait to block until the row is complete or warning.

data "vergeio_vm_import" "example" {
  id = "8f73f8bcc9c9f1aaba32f733bfc295acaf548554"
}

output "imported_vm" {
  value = data.vergeio_vm_import.example.vm_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) vm_imports key, a 40 character hex string. Set this or name.
- `name` (String) Import name. Set this or id. VergeOS does not require the name to be unique.
- `timeout` (String) How long to wait when wait is true. A duration such as "10m" or "30s". Defaults to 10m.
- `wait` (Boolean) Wait until the import is complete or warning, or return an error when it fails. Omit to wait. Set false to read the current row, including one that is still importing.

### Read-Only

- `aborted` (Boolean) True when the import was aborted.
- `failed_drive_count` (Number) How many drives VergeOS has already failed.
- `file_id` (Number) Media-catalog file id when the source is a file.
- `guest_agent_preinstalled` (Boolean) Whether the guest agent was marked as already installed. Null when the server is older than VergeOS 26.2.
- `importing` (Boolean) True while VergeOS is still importing.
- `no_optical_drives` (Boolean) Whether optical drives were skipped.
- `override_drive_interface` (String) Drive interface that replaced the source interface.
- `override_nic_interface` (String) NIC interface that replaced the source interface.
- `preferred_tier` (String) Storage tier recorded on the import, from 1 through 5.
- `preserve_bios_serial` (Boolean) Whether the source SMBIOS serial was kept. Null when the server is older than VergeOS 26.2.
- `preserve_drive_format` (Boolean) Whether the source disk format was kept.
- `preserve_macs` (Boolean) Whether source MAC addresses were kept.
- `replicate_tags` (Boolean) Whether VMware tags were copied onto the VM. Null when the server is older than VergeOS 26.2.
- `shared_object` (Number) Shared-object id when the source is a shared object.
- `status` (String) Import status: initializing, importing, complete, aborted, error, or warning.
- `status_info` (String) Detail VergeOS reported for status.
- `uuid` (String) Source VM UUID.
- `vm_id` (Number) Key of the VM created by the import. Null until VergeOS assigns one.
- `volume` (String) NAS volume key when the source is a volume.
- `volume_path` (String) OVA or OVF path on volume.
